card.name: Words just before a drug or measure term
card.fires_on: Small connecting words or partial numbers in drug-label text that come right before a quantity, a drug noun or a condition term. Examples are "contain", "maximal", "parent" and "to" in a time range.

modes.label: Before a drug noun
modes.description: Modifier words like "parent" or "maximal" that come before drug or concentration terms.
modes.example: due to accumulation of<< parent>> drug and/or failure of metabolite formation

modes.label: Before a number or range
modes.description: A linking word or a space just before a dose or time value.

modes.label: Verb or link before a substance
modes.description: A verb or preposition that leads into a toxin or basis term.
modes.example: Oleanders<< contain>> a toxin called Cardenolide Gly

card.writes: It leans toward molecule and atom words and away from bacterial words, which is a weak and mixed effect.
